name: Google Chrome Current Windows Security Technical Implementation Guide
description: This Security Technical Implementation Guide is published as a tool to improve the security of Department of Defense (DOD) information systems. The requirements are derived from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 and related documents. Comments or proposed revisions to this document should be sent via email to the following address: disa.stig_spt@mail.mil.

rules.title: Firewall traversal from remote host must be disabled.

suggestions.title: Allow SmartScreen (legacy browser CSP)
suggestions.name: AllowSmartScreen
suggestions.rationale: Safe Browsing is Chrome ADMX (SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel); SmartScreen CSP is Edge-oriented — use Chrome ADMX in Settings Catalog.
suggestions.description: SmartScreen for legacy Browser CSP area.
